description: Utility functions for extracting probability metrics from various speech-to-text service result frames, including Whisper, GPT-4o, and Deepgram.

methods.name: Optional[float] extract_whisper_probability(frame: TranscriptionFrame)
methods.description: Extracts a probability score from a TranscriptionFrame resulting from Whisper-based STT services by converting avg_logprob to a probability.

methods.name: Optional[float] extract_openai_gpt4o_probability(frame: TranscriptionFrame)
methods.description: Extracts a probability score from a TranscriptionFrame resulting from OpenAI GPT-4o-transcribe STT service by converting log probabilities to a probability.

methods.name: Optional[float] extract_deepgram_probability(frame: TranscriptionFrame)
methods.description: Extracts a probability or confidence score from a TranscriptionFrame resulting from Deepgram STT service, considering alternative and word-level confidences.
